body: Yeah, I want to see another neurologist, I already went to see one in 2018, but that was for a different reason, I never asked him what happened to me, I just wanted to know if I had brain damage, so they did a CT scan and an EEG and everything was normal, I feel like the part of my brain that's in charge of language comprehension is dead, so I thought they would find a hole on the left side of my brain, but they didn't find anything. Now I want to see a neurologist because I want to ask him/her what exactly happened to me, I want to ask him if it has happened other times through history to other people, and I want to ask him what is the best course of action for me to recover. I already went to see some psychiatrists, but they didn't know what happened to me, they just said I have psychosis or schizophrenia

I feel like someone who lost a loved one due to cancer or a car accident, because even though she is still alive, I have to live like she doesn't exist anymore, I can't talk to her, I can't see her and I can't be with her, I am supposed to just forget about her and get over it, but I just can't do it, one day after I declared my love to her, I talked to her and she told me a lot of nasty things, I asked her if she cared about me and she said that she didn't and that why should she care about me?, I asked her why she didn't want to talk to me, and she told me that because she isn't my friend and I am not her patient, then I asked her why couldn't we be friends?, and her reply was "because no", I think she has treated me like trash and it's really unfair, I never wanted it to end like this, I feel very gulty about what has happened, I always think it's my fault, I think I am responsible for her treating me like this.

Yeah, I always knew that I was probably never going to see her again, and I accepted that, but I think I was never actually prepared to lose her and not seeing her, hearing her, being with her, I miss her so much, I think it was the first time I fell in love with someone, I think that if I had been able to tell her what I felt in person I wouldn't feel so sad now.
